description.intro: The Nike Uruguay child 25 26 Stadium Dri-Fit T-shirt allows the youngest to defend the colors of Uruguay with the same pride as their idols. Ideal for training, playing or cheering from home.
key_benefits: Faithful design: Official T-shirt with the embroidered shield and light blue colors.
Dri-FIT fabric: Keeps skin dry and comfortable all day.
Youth fit: Designed to offer freedom in every movement.
Professional inspiration: Same as what gamers use, but for kids.
